title: canvasobjectconnections
description: `canvasobjectconnections` queries the connections of an arbitrary object in a specified parent canvas for introspection. Select the target with an `object` index, then use messages such as `inlets`, `outlets`, `inlet`, `outlet`, `inconnect`, or `outconnect`; results are emitted as lists, with connection queries reporting connected object IDs or full connection data suitable for restoration.
